types: All observed clocks and upper bound strict positive integer UTC epoch milliseconds; bool forbidden. release_time_ms and broker_original_release_time_ms are null for sampled current snapshot. No implicit precision conversion.
release_time_upper_bound_ms: equals ingested_time_ms; bound only, never exact broker publication evidence
event_time_ms: equals pinned native QuoteEvent.assumed_utc_epoch_ms; raw SymbolInfoTick time_msc unchanged under Exness UTC0 contract
binding_sha256: canonical nonsecret provenance JSON SHA256, checked against configured fixed binding
attestation: Separate VerifiedBinding produced by readonly codec after live EA exact company/server matches explicit nonsecret operator configuration; defaults empty => unknown. Never inferred from caller true or provider prefix.
activation: first accepted event_time_ms; fixed checkpoint identity; no Oct08/admissions/eventplan
online_boundary: removed_ms=loaded_ms=ready_ms=activation first event; no pre-start history or fill; cold native causal warmup required
duplicate: exact same time_msc/Bid/Ask no consume; same timestamp different prices rejected; reverse time rejected
fill: virtual request binds decision cutoff_time_ms and input cursor; event_time_ms > request cutoff_time_ms+100 AND later cursor; signal and bar event times unchanged
cadence: serial INFO250ms; sampled current BidAsk, not full ordered tick replay
tests: sourcefree fixture only; includes delayed event clock vs decision cutoff; no actual broker/MT5 readiness proof
supersedes: clock_contract_v001.json preserved as rejected proposed exact release ordering, not used by runtime
